svg.text: model.py _spatial_encoding() / _voxel_pos_embedding() · one learned Fourier code of a voxel centre, shared by every token that has a position — and by the decoder’s 4096 queries
1. The quantity — the voxel’s normalised centre
Normalised, not metres: every recording has its own Aria world frame with
an arbitrary origin, and the splits are participant-level.
Pad slots take a different branch
learned vector. (0 − 0.5)/16 would land a third of
a cell outside the corner — i.e. on top of voxel 1,
reading as “a box on the floor” instead of “no box”.
It encodes the same cell centre the index tables encoded: this adds continuity, not resolution.
_nearest_voxel_ijk still snaps the box centre first — sub-voxel position is change B2, unbuilt.
2. The code — the three axes mix before cos/sin
std (sx, sy, sz) from --voxel_query_fourier_scale (one value, or three).
cos(w₁x + w₂y + w₃z) — joint in position, not a per-axis sum
Why the init std is per axis
The cells are not cubic. Measured over the nine production grids, the z cell is
13.3–14.6 cm in every kitchen while x runs 16.8–41.7 and y 12.6–46.6 cm.
3. Replace or add, and who receives it
three per-axis streams: a token is a scalar
Only tokens carrying a full (i, j, k). A type marker keeps them apart.
4. Why a Fourier code and not the index tables
cosine similarity between two voxel codes as they move apart along one axis
cells apart along one axis (16 cells spans the whole kitchen)
Only one of the three terms changes, and two rows (eₓ[8], e_y[8]) are
shared outright. The third pair, e_z[8] and e_z[9], is independent, so it
contributes nothing to the dot product: sim = 2H / 3H = 2/3, whether the
cells are 1 apart or 15. No smoothness is available to it.
The index tables are a 48-vector vocabulary for 4096 voxels: eₓ[i] + e_y[j] + e_z[k].
DISCRETE — eₓ[4] and eₓ[5] are independent 768-vectors with no prior that they are adjacent, so
neighbouring voxels start out as unrelated as distant ones.
ADDITIVE — every voxel’s code decomposes per axis, so no cell can be made distinctive without
smearing the same signal across its whole row, column and layer.
distance between the codes of voxel (8,8,8) and …
axis_sum cannot go below its floor
√(2/6) = 0.577. p − p′ differences two independent rows when
one axis differs and six when all three do — so the ratio is fixed
by the construction, not by anything the model can learn.
measures 0.570 and 0.408 on its own init.
The legacy ÷√D pinned the query at norm 0.707 against
query:evidence regime against a 50:1 one. Init √(3H) = 48.0
is the norm of the three index rows it replaces.
one parameter set, owned by the model
the bound method itself, not a copy
A query and an input token at one voxel carry the identical vector —
by construction, not because two call sites agree on a formula.
The decoder is handed _voxel_pos_embedding itself. Before this flag,
--voxel_query_type fourier gave the queries a private W_r while every input
token kept the tables: two unrelated vocabularies, not one shared code.
